prompt.text:
Repair the buggy source below without changing the required API.

File contract: Write CommonJS module solution.js and export the named function.
Required API: exports.rollingChecksums = function(values, window) returning number[] | null
Behavior: For every complete window, emit the position-weighted checksum sum((offset+1)*value). Reject a zero window (and negative where representable). A window longer than input returns a non-null empty result; do not mutate input.
Visible example: values [2,4,1,3] with window 3 return [13,15].

Buggy source to repair:

exports.rollingChecksums=(values,window)=>{if(window<=0)return null;const out=[];for(let i=0;i+window<=values.length;i++)out.push(values.slice(i,i+window).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0));return out}

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
